native_rules: User LevelEnd snapshots event data first, captures current basic/inventory/active references, clears the level save, conditionally persists cloche from level31 with int32 overflow preserved, calls SuperDuke/MultiplierToken end owners, then branches on active state.

On win, episode/new-UX/mission/lantern dispatch precedes BasicUserData.IncrementLevel. Positive collected level coin is reconciled against the current inventory balance using After-currentCoin; stars are assigned from absolute Star.After only outside side progression. Story wins re-resolve current user after nightmare callbacks; side-progression wins use their own completion branch.

On failure, quit state6 and no-possible-move state5 bypass episode failure. Side failures dispatch their event/quit-detection branch; normal failures use the normal event branch. Failure stats precede non-forced backend sync.

Milestone packages are claimed only when the actual milestone snapshot After>Before. Multiplier-token purchase and UpdateEventsOnLevelWin remain ordered required owner calls; that aggregation body is not replaced with fabricated inactive managers.

Remaining-end adds ExtraCoins only when positive, reads packed Madness inventory before checking snapshot validity, updates count only if the snapshot is valid and greater, then invokes multiplier(false), event/mission completion and non-forced backend sync. LevelManager wrapper skips admin sessions and otherwise invokes user completion before reward analytics with the original opaque DTO payload.

Basic increment resolves four event managers before null-session checks. Side progression marks the current inventory and scores2 times any active multiplier. League updates league level and scores by index modulo10 (2=>3,5=>5,9=>10,other=>1); ordinary levels compare against native published max, update normal level and score difficulty (positive1=>3,2=>5,otherpositive=>10,nonpositive=>1). Ordinary progression dispatches story update before leaderboard writes.

Leaderboard gates use the captured four managers. KingsCup remaining-time is queried again after the leaderboard write, rather than reusing the first result; native mission34 and league crown stats retain that order.

Normal/league writes reset native LevelTryCount and HardLevelBackgroundIndex to0 only when their stored level value changes. The pre-increment mission12 gate reads LevelTryCount==1. Normal level always writes its value and triggers the level update callback, even on unchanged values. Actual native key strings are separately resolved; database composition is still required and no alternate PlayerPrefs keys were invented.

Coin/star updates clamp negative signed values to0, write storage before notifying their actual delegates, and preserve partial field writes if a storage callback fails. AddCoins retains unchecked int32 addition, optional coin mission21 and nonzero transaction tracking order.

Madness packing decodes step bits14..19, event bits20..28 and count from0..13 plus29..31. Native step/event writes are deliberately unmasked, including out-of-range spill into other bits; count portions are extracted. Only a resulting all-zero inventory resets to native default16384 (step1).

The formal verifier now accepts either native dialog/readiness scheduling order. It still uses real model events, automatic WinFail/check gates, actual logo close/queue, real remaining conversion and coin callbacks; no manual state or readiness writes were introduced.
